# Thyme-Me support policy

Thyme-Me is a free-of-charge personal project provided without a service-level
agreement, guaranteed response time, or promise of indefinite maintenance.

## Platforms

- Windows 11 x64 is the supported platform for Thyme-Me 1.x.
- Windows 10 22H2 x64 is a compatibility target only. Windows 10 Home and Pro
  reached Microsoft end of support, and Thyme-Me does not promise future fixes for
  Windows 10-specific problems.
- ARM64 and x86 packages are not published for Thyme-Me 1.x.

An operating system is not claimed as verified until installation, launch, and
the documented smoke tests have run on that system. Build compatibility alone is
not rendering validation.

## Getting help

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible bugs and include the Thyme-Me version, Windows
version, architecture, and non-sensitive reproduction steps. Do not attach your
database, descriptions, tracked application data, personal paths, or credentials.
